tags.description: La Posada was built by the Santa Fe Railway in 1929 for travelers coming through the Southwest by train, so the front door was here – facing the railroad tracks. Just east of the entry walkway is a large lawn centered on a flagpole.

tags.description: Within this lawn you will find a small stone platform with an ornate wishing well. The wishing well shows up in piles of period photos. He original was auctioned off, the current well is a recreation.

tags.description: A little fruit orchard, just west of the Maze. We have tried a variety of fruit trees, such as: Pear, Plumb, Apple & Cherry. This is a hard place for trees, as everything here is buffeted by the strong, prevailing Southwest winds.
